COMP-dns.desc: DNS probes: system resolver, --server custom, --doh RFC8484 (hand-rolled wire), literal short-circuit, RCODE surfacing

COMP-tcp.desc: TCP connect probes with classified failure modes (timeout/refused/reset/unreachable) and latency

COMP-tls.desc: TLS handshake with SNI, ALPN, cipher, cert subject/issuer/validity; --insecure mode

COMP-http.desc: HTTPS/HTTP1.1 single request per address over TLS, status/redirect/body-size

COMP-http2.desc: HTTP/2 single request over ALPN h2 connection, protocol identity preserved on failure

COMP-http3.desc: HTTP/3 QUIC probe over UDP path, distinct from TCP path

COMP-probe.desc: Repeated probing with latency stats (min/p50/p90/p95/p99/max/jitter/failure-dist) for tcp/tls/http/http2/http3

COMP-route.desc: Linux UDP/ICMP traceroute, root/CAP_NET_RAW gated, IPv4-only

COMP-diagnose.desc: Deterministic evidence-based diagnostic engine (layer.rs/connectivity.rs/filtering.rs/dns.rs), no network I/O

COMP-model.desc: typed observation model: DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP/latency/probe/diagnosis; serde Serialize

COMP-report.desc: human + --json rendering of all observation types

COMP-lib.desc: public library API: async probe functions with explicit timeouts, bounded concurrency (parallel_map)

DEC-001.rationale: User explicitly prefers 功能性开发为主 (functional-first): ship features + fix bugs + tighten correctness over architecture/docs refactor churn until backlog is drained
DEC-001.alternatives_rejected: architecture polish, extensive doc rewrites, test-only rounds

DEC-002.rationale: Maintain zero-new-dependency pattern: hand-rolled protocol code (DoH wire parser, etc.) reuses in-tree rustls/hyper/hickory/quinn rather than adding deps

DEC-003.rationale: --follow redirects deliberately NOT implemented: a redirect is an observation, the tool does not chase it (README documents this)

DEC-004.rationale: Coverage gate is whole-crate >=80 (currently 93.37%); per-module gaps (http3 ~74%) deferred — diminishing returns, bespoke misbehaving-QUIC fixtures

DEC-005.rationale: New milestone (2026-08-22): user invoked graph-engineering to start a new milestone. Quality convergence already reached (93.37% cov, all CI gates green); enter FEATURE EVOLUTION mode to deliver user-visible new capabilities.
DEC-005.alternatives_rejected: more quality-convergence rounds on an already-plateaued repo; idle/QUEIESCE

TASK-sni-override.summary: CLI --sni <name> override on tls/http/http2/http3/probe: present a chosen hostname as SNI (+HTTP Host) while probing the resolved target addresses; validates certs for that name even when connecting to an IP literal; library already separates destination from sni

TASK-sni-diagnose.summary: diagnose --sni <name>: run the full probe pipeline presenting a chosen hostname (SNI/Host) instead of the target, so a full diagnosis can be scoped to how a given IP behaves for a given domain

ISS-sni-not-exposed.summary: The CLI exposes no way to override SNI/Host: probing an IP literal (e.g. a CDN edge or --server result) always presents the literal as SNI, and --insecure is required even when the target IP belongs to a known hostname; the library (tls::probe(dest, sni, ...)) already separates destination from sni, so the gap is CLI-only

CHG-sni-override.summary: --sni <name> on tls/http/http2/http3/probe presents the chosen hostname as SNI (+ HTTP Host) while probing the target addresses; human reports now surface the presented name when it differs from the destination literal; 3 fixture-gated integration tests

CHG-sni-diagnose.summary: diagnose --sni <name> presents the chosen hostname as SNI/Host across the full probe pipeline while the target stays the probe set; CLI test pins output surfaces the name and keeps the literal as destination

TASK-path-http.summary:
--path

on http/http2/http3/probe: the probes currently hard-code the request path to /, so path-dependent behaviors (WAF rules, CDN cache keys, per-endpoint certs, health endpoints) cannot be observed; add a path parameter through the library probe fns, model (HttpObservation.path) and report

ISS-path-hardcoded.summary: HTTP/1.1/2/3 probes always request "/", so a user cannot observe how a destination behaves for a specific resource (e.g. /healthz or a path behind a WAF); the method (--method) and hostname (--sni) are controllable but the path is not

TASK-header-http.summary: --header NAME:VALUE (repeatable) on http/http2/http3/probe to send custom request headers (e.g. Authorization, User-Agent, cookie) — currently the probes hard-code user-agent/accept and allow no request customization

CHG-path-http.summary: --path <path> on http/http2/http3 + probe --protocol http*; HttpObservation.path; human report shows non-default path; api-baseline regenerated (probe fns gained a path arg); 2 fixture-gated tests proving wire routing

CHG-header-http.summary: --header NAME:VALUE on http/http2/http3 + probe; headers param through all HTTP probes and repeats; fixture answers 202 on marker header, proving wire delivery on TCP+QUIC; malformed header rejected; api-baseline regenerated

ISS-headers-not-sendable.summary: HTTP probes hard-coded user-agent/accept and allowed no request customization (no Authorization/cookie/etc.), so endpoints requiring a header could not be probed truthfully

TASK-http-headers.summary: Capture and render HTTP response headers in http/http2/http3 observations: currently only status/protocol/location/body-size are recorded, so server-software/CDN/proxy evidence (Server, Via, Alt-Svc, Set-Cookie, cache-control, x-*) is invisible; add a bounded headers list to HttpObservation, render a curated set in report, JSON carries all

ISS-headers-not-observed.summary: The HTTP probes discard the response headers entirely; a user cannot see which server/CDN/proxy answered, how it caches, or what cookies/set-cookie were set — core evidence for network diagnosis (identifying a WAF, a CDN hit, a proxy hop)
